genesis.15.p1.b1.text: “Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward.”

genesis.15.p1.b2.text: “O Lord GOD, what can You give me, since I remain childless …”

genesis.15.p1.b3.text: “Behold, You have given me no offspring, so a servant in my household will be my heir.”

genesis.15.p2.b4.text: “This one will not be your heir, but one who comes from your own body will be your heir.”

genesis.15.p2.b5.text: “Now look to the heavens and count the stars, if you are able.”

genesis.15.p2.b7.text: Abram believed the LORD, and it was credited to him as righteousness.

genesis.15.p3.b8.text: “I am the LORD, who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land to possess.”

genesis.15.p3.b9.text: “Lord GOD, how can I know that I will possess it?”

genesis.15.p3.b10.text: “Bring Me a heifer, a goat, and a ram, each three years old, along with a turtledove and a young pigeon.”

genesis.15.p3.b11.text: And the birds of prey descended on the carcasses, but Abram drove them away.

genesis.15.p4.b12.text: As the sun was setting, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and suddenly great terror and darkness overwhelmed him.

genesis.15.p4.b13.text: “Know for certain that your descendants will be strangers in a land that is not their own, and they will be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.

genesis.15.p4.b14.text: … and afterward they will depart with many possessions.

genesis.15.p4.b15.text: You, however, will go to your fathers in peace … In the fourth generation your descendants will return here …

genesis.15.p5.b16.text: When the sun had set and darkness had fallen,

genesis.15.p5.b17.text: behold, a smoking firepot and a flaming torch appeared and passed between the halves of the carcasses.

genesis.15.p6.b18.text: On that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying,

genesis.15.p6.b19.text: “To your descendants I have given this land—from the river of Egypt to the great River Euphrates—

genesis.15.p6.b20.text: the land of the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites, Hittites, Perizzites, Rephaites, Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites, and Jebusites.”
